settings.support.blurb.original: If you find this plugin useful, consider supporting its development:
settings.support.blurb.translation: Jika pemalam ini berguna kepada anda, pertimbangkanlah untuk menyokong pembangunannya:

settings.support.mission.original: …and help seed a bigger vision: technology that serves people and planet..
settings.support.mission.translation: …dan bantulah menyemai wawasan yang lebih besar: teknologi yang berkhidmat kepada manusia dan bumi.

settings.templates.templaterFile.desc.original: Path to the templater plugin template file to use
settings.templates.templaterFile.desc.translation: Laluan ke fail templat pemalam Templater yang hendak digunakan

settings.transcripts.info.original: Transcript settings control how and where your extracted notes are saved, which youtube data API key to use (required for channel/playlist processing), and optional language-translation parameters.
settings.transcripts.info.translation: Tetapan transkrip menentukan cara dan tempat nota yang diekstrak disimpan, kunci YouTube data API yang mana digunakan (diperlukan untuk memproses saluran dan senarai main), serta parameter terjemahan yang bersifat pilihan.

settings.transcripts.rootFolder.desc.original: The root folder where transcript subfolders will be organized (e.g., inbox, notes, etc.)
settings.transcripts.rootFolder.desc.translation: Folder akar tempat subfolder transkrip disusun (cth. inbox, notes, dsb.)

settings.transcripts.youtubeApiKey.desc.original: Your Google cloud console API key for accessing public YouTube transcripts (not an OAUTH token). Required for downloading channels and playlists.
settings.transcripts.youtubeApiKey.desc.translation: Kunci API Google Cloud Console untuk mencapai transkrip YouTube awam (bukan token OAUTH). Diperlukan untuk memuat turun saluran dan senarai main.

settings.transcripts.scrapeCreatorsApiKe.original: Optional key for scrapecreators transcript service. When set, used as the primary transcript method. Get a free key at app.scrapecreators.com (100 requests free). Recommended for reliable transcript retrieval; direct YouTube extraction breaks when YouTube changes how captions are served.
settings.transcripts.scrapeCreatorsApiKe.translation: Kunci pilihan bagi perkhidmatan transkrip scrapecreators. Apabila ditetapkan, ia menjadi kaedah transkrip utama. Dapatkan kunci percuma di app.scrapecreators.com (100 permintaan percuma). Disyorkan bagi perolehan transkrip yang boleh dipercayai; pengekstrakan terus daripada YouTube akan rosak setiap kali YouTube menukar cara sari kata disajikan.

settings.transcripts.supadataApiKey.desc.original: Optional key for supadata transcript service. When set, used as the primary transcript method (if no scrapecreators key). Get a key at supadata.ai.
settings.transcripts.supadataApiKey.desc.translation: Kunci pilihan bagi perkhidmatan transkrip supadata. Apabila ditetapkan, ia menjadi kaedah transkrip utama (jika tiada kunci scrapecreators). Dapatkan kunci di supadata.ai.

settings.transcripts.translateLanguage.d.original: Target language code for translation (e.g., en, es, fr, de). Use "en" to keep content in english.
settings.transcripts.translateLanguage.d.translation: Kod bahasa sasaran bagi terjemahan (cth. en, es, fr, de). Gunakan “en” untuk mengekalkan kandungan dalam bahasa Inggeris.

settings.transcripts.translateCountry.de.original: Target country/region code for translation (e.g., us, gb, ca). Used for region-specific language variants.
settings.transcripts.translateCountry.de.translation: Kod negara/wilayah sasaran bagi terjemahan (cth. us, gb, ca). Digunakan untuk varian bahasa mengikut wilayah.

settings.llm.info.original: Choose an AI provider, enter its API key, and pick a model. Temperature controls creativity; max tokens caps output length. OpenRouter is recommended for reliability; Google's gemini-2.5-flash is cheaper, but its lower-cost tiers can be throttled.
settings.llm.info.translation: Pilih pembekal AI, masukkan kunci API-nya, kemudian pilih model. Temperature mengawal daya cipta; max tokens mengehadkan panjang keluaran. OpenRouter disyorkan demi kebolehharapan; gemini-2.5-flash daripada Google lebih murah, tetapi peringkatnya yang murah mungkin dikenakan had kadar.

settings.llm.provider.desc.original: Provider used for summarization. OpenRouter is recommended for reliability; lower-cost Gemini tiers can be throttled.
settings.llm.provider.desc.translation: Pembekal yang digunakan untuk meringkaskan. OpenRouter disyorkan demi kebolehharapan; peringkat Gemini yang murah mungkin dikenakan had kadar.

settings.llm.apiKey.desc.cloud.original: Stored in Obsidian secret storage, not in plugin data.
settings.llm.apiKey.desc.cloud.translation: Disimpan dalam storan rahsia Obsidian, bukan dalam data pemalam.

settings.llm.apiKey.desc.ollama.original: Server URL, stored in plugin data.
settings.llm.apiKey.desc.ollama.translation: URL pelayan, disimpan dalam data pemalam.

settings.llm.model.desc.original: Select a preset model or type a custom model name below.
settings.llm.model.desc.translation: Pilih model pratetap atau taipkan nama model tersuai di bawah.

settings.llm.modelParams.descCustom.original: Required: this model isn't in the registry — set context window, max output, and reserve % so token budgeting can size requests safely.
settings.llm.modelParams.descCustom.translation: Wajib: model ini tiada dalam daftar — tetapkan tetingkap konteks, keluaran maksimum dan peratus simpanan supaya belanjawan token dapat menyukat saiz permintaan dengan selamat.

settings.llm.modelParams.descOverride.original: These are this model's token limits, prefilled from known data. Edit a field to override it for this provider and model.
settings.llm.modelParams.descOverride.translation: Inilah had token model ini, diisi awal daripada data yang diketahui. Suntinglah mana-mana medan untuk mengatasinya bagi pembekal dan model ini.

settings.llm.contextWindow.desc.original: Total context window in thousands of tokens (e.g., 400 for 400k tokens)
settings.llm.contextWindow.desc.translation: Jumlah tetingkap konteks dalam ribuan token (cth. 400 bagi 400k token)

settings.llm.maxOutput.desc.original: Maximum output tokens in thousands (e.g., 128 for 128k tokens)
settings.llm.maxOutput.desc.translation: Bilangan token keluaran maksimum dalam ribuan (cth. 128 bagi 128k token)

settings.llm.inputMax.desc.original: Explicit input cap if vendor publishes one (leave empty to auto calculate)
settings.llm.inputMax.desc.translation: Had masukan yang nyata jika pembekal menerbitkannya (biarkan kosong untuk kira sendiri)

settings.llm.reservePct.desc.original: Safety reserve for output tokens (0.10 = 10%, default: {default})
settings.llm.reservePct.desc.translation: Simpanan keselamatan bagi token keluaran (0.10 = 10%, lalai: {default})

settings.llm.temperature.desc.original: Controls randomness of output (0-1). Lower is more focused, higher is more creative. Current value: {value}
settings.llm.temperature.desc.translation: Mengawal kerawakan keluaran (0-1). Lebih rendah lebih fokus, lebih tinggi lebih kreatif. Nilai semasa: {value}

settings.noteFormat.prependDate.name.translation: Letak tarikh di hadapan tajuk nota

settings.noteFormat.prependDate.desc.original: Automatically add date to the beginning of note filenames
settings.noteFormat.prependDate.desc.translation: Letakkan tarikh secara automatik di pangkal nama fail nota

settings.noteFormat.dateFormat.desc.original: Format for date prepended to note titles
settings.noteFormat.dateFormat.desc.translation: Format tarikh yang diletakkan di hadapan tajuk nota

settings.prompts.systemFast.desc.original: Instructions for the llms behavior when generating fast summaries
settings.prompts.systemFast.desc.translation: Arahan bagi kelakuan model bahasa semasa menghasilkan ringkasan pantas

settings.prompts.userFast.desc.original: Specific instructions for summarizing the transcript quickly and concisely
settings.prompts.userFast.desc.translation: Arahan khusus untuk meringkaskan transkrip dengan pantas dan padat

settings.prompts.userFast.placeholder.original: Please summarize the following YouTube transcript...

settings.prompts.systemExtensive.desc.original: Instructions for the llms behavior when generating detailed, comprehensive summaries
settings.prompts.systemExtensive.desc.translation: Arahan bagi kelakuan model bahasa semasa menghasilkan ringkasan yang terperinci dan menyeluruh

settings.prompts.userExtensive.desc.original: Specific instructions for creating detailed and structured notes from the transcript
settings.prompts.userExtensive.desc.translation: Arahan khusus untuk menghasilkan nota yang terperinci dan berstruktur daripada transkrip

settings.prompts.userExtensive.placehold.original: From the transcript below, create detailed and structured notes...
settings.prompts.userExtensive.placehold.translation: Daripada transkrip di bawah, hasilkan nota yang terperinci dan berstruktur…

settings.prompts.defaultMode.desc.original: Choose the default summary mode to use when the plugin starts. Fast summary mode skips timestamp links for quicker processing.
settings.prompts.defaultMode.desc.translation: Pilih mod ringkasan yang digunakan apabila pemalam bermula. Mod ringkasan pantas melangkau pautan cap masa supaya pemprosesan lebih laju.

settings.prompts.timestampLinks.desc.original: Add links to each numbered section heading that jump to the corresponding timestamp in the YouTube video (note: disabled in fast summary mode)
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.desc.translation: Tambahkan pautan pada setiap tajuk bahagian bernombor yang melompat ke cap masa sepadan dalam video YouTube (perhatian: dimatikan dalam mod ringkasan pantas)

settings.prompts.timestampLinks.infoTool.original: When enabled, reduces first pass tokens by 12% to make room for links. Automatically disabled in fast summary mode.
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.infoTool.translation: Apabila dihidupkan, token pusingan pertama dikurangkan 12% untuk memberi ruang kepada pautan. Dimatikan secara automatik dalam mod ringkasan pantas.

settings.advanced.info.original: Advanced settings for debugging and troubleshooting. Enable debug logging to get detailed information appended to each note for technical support.
settings.advanced.info.translation: Tetapan lanjutan untuk menyahpepijat dan menyelesaikan masalah. Hidupkan log nyahpepijat supaya maklumat terperinci dilampirkan pada setiap nota bagi sokongan teknikal.

settings.advanced.debugLogging.desc.original: Enable detailed debug logs. When enabled, debug information will be appended to each note as a hidden callout for troubleshooting.
settings.advanced.debugLogging.desc.translation: Hidupkan log nyahpepijat yang terperinci. Apabila dihidupkan, maklumat nyahpepijat dilampirkan pada setiap nota sebagai callout tersembunyi bagi menyelesaikan masalah.

settings.advanced.debugLogging.infoToolt.original: When enabled, debug information will be collected and added to notes as a hidden callout instead of being logged to the console.
settings.advanced.debugLogging.infoToolt.translation: Apabila dihidupkan, maklumat nyahpepijat dikumpulkan dan ditambah pada nota sebagai callout tersembunyi, bukan dicatatkan ke konsol.

license.required.message.original: You must accept the plugin license before using this feature.
license.required.message.translation: Anda mesti menerima lesen pemalam sebelum menggunakan ciri ini.

license.required.instruction.original: Please go to the plugin settings and accept the license terms to continue.
license.required.instruction.translation: Sila pergi ke tetapan pemalam dan terima terma lesen untuk meneruskan.

license.required.step2.original: Scroll down to the "Community Plugins" section in the sidebar
license.required.step2.translation: Tatal ke bawah sehingga bahagian pemalam komuniti pada bar sisi

license.required.step3.original: Find "Tubesage" in the Community Plugins list

license.required.step5.original: Toggle "Accept license & disclaimer" to enable the plugin
license.required.step5.translation: Hidupkan “Terima lesen dan penafian” untuk mengaktifkan pemalam

notice.apiKey.missing.original: Youtube transcript plugin: no API key configured for {provider}. Add your API key in the plugin settings.
notice.apiKey.missing.translation: Pemalam transkrip Youtube: tiada kunci API ditetapkan untuk {provider}. Sila tambah kunci API anda dalam tetapan pemalam.

notice.debugNote.created.original: Error note created with debug information: {file}
notice.debugNote.created.translation: Nota ralat dengan maklumat nyahpepijat telah dicipta: {file}

notice.debugNote.failed.original: Error: {error} (Also failed to create debug note)

notice.transcript.noTimestamps.original: Warning: No timestamps found in transcript. Timestamps are required for proper processing.
notice.transcript.noTimestamps.translation: Amaran: tiada cap masa dalam transkrip. Cap masa diperlukan untuk pemprosesan.

notice.templater.required.original: Error: Templater plugin is required but not installed or enabled
notice.templater.required.translation: Ralat: pemalam Templater diperlukan tetapi belum dipasang atau diaktifkan

notice.templater.missing.original: Youtube transcript plugin requires the Templater plugin. Please install and enable it.
notice.templater.missing.translation: Pemalam transkrip Youtube memerlukan pemalam Templater. Sila pasang dan aktifkannya.

notice.collection.fetchingPlaylist.translation: Sedang mengambil senarai main dengan ID: {id}

notice.collection.fetchingPlaylistVideos.translation: Sedang mengambil video daripada senarai main...
Sedang mengambil video daripada senarai main (sambungan)...

notice.collection.safetyLimit.original: Reached safety limit of {limit} videos. Processing the first {limit} videos.
notice.collection.safetyLimit.translation: Had keselamatan {limit} video telah dicapai. {limit} video pertama akan diproses.

notice.timestamps.adding.translation: Sedang menambah pautan cap masa dengan LLM...

notice.timestamps.retrying.translation: Sedang mencuba semula dengan had token lebih rendah...

notice.timestamps.added.original: Added timestamp links to {count} section headings
notice.timestamps.added.translation: Pautan cap masa ditambah pada {count} tajuk bahagian

notice.translate.emptyResponse.original: Failed to translate content (empty response from LLM)
notice.translate.emptyResponse.translation: Gagal menterjemah kandungan (respons kosong daripada LLM)

notice.models.apiKeyMissing.original: {provider} API key is missing. Cannot fetch models.
notice.models.apiKeyMissing.translation: Kunci API {provider} tiada. Model tidak dapat diambil.

notice.models.parseFailed.original: Could not parse {provider} models from API response.
notice.models.parseFailed.translation: Model {provider} tidak dapat dibaca daripada respons API.

notice.timestamps.addedChunked.original: Added {count} timestamp links using chunked processing
notice.timestamps.addedChunked.translation: Menambah {count} pautan cap masa dengan pemprosesan berbahagian

modal.create.titlePlaceholder.original: Leave empty to use YouTube title
modal.create.titlePlaceholder.translation: Biarkan kosong untuk menggunakan tajuk YouTube

modal.create.urlInvalid.original: Not a valid YouTube URL. Only video, playlist, and channel urls are supported.
modal.create.urlInvalid.translation: Bukan URL YouTube yang sah. Hanya URL video, senarai main dan saluran disokong.

modal.create.title.original: Tubesage: create note from YouTube transcript
modal.create.title.translation: Tubesage: cipta nota daripada transkrip YouTube

modal.create.urlPlaylist.original: YouTube channel or playlist URL detected
modal.create.urlPlaylist.translation: Dikesan URL saluran atau senarai main YouTube

modal.create.videoCountPrompt.original: How many videos would you like to process? Max hard limit is 50.
modal.create.videoCountPrompt.translation: Berapa banyak video hendak diproses? Had maksimumnya 50.

modal.create.fastModeDesc.original: Enable for shorter, quicker summaries (skips timestamp links)
modal.create.fastModeDesc.translation: Ringkasan lebih pendek dan pantas (melangkau pautan cap masa)

modal.templatePicker.empty.original: No template files found in "{folder}" folder. Make sure your template folder is correctly configured in Templater settings.
modal.templatePicker.empty.translation: Tiada fail templat dalam folder “{folder}”. Pastikan folder templat ditetapkan dengan betul dalam tetapan Templater.

modal.template.title.original: Example template: copy and place in your templater plugin specified template directory
modal.template.title.translation: Templat contoh: salin ke folder templat yang ditetapkan dalam Templater

modal.template.explanation.original: This is the example templater plugin template used for YouTube transcript notes. You can customize this template for your own needs.
modal.template.explanation.translation: Ini ialah templat contoh Templater untuk nota transkrip YouTube. Anda boleh mengubahnya mengikut keperluan.

notice.job.saveFailed.original: Could not save the job: {error}. The video may still be processing
notice.job.saveFailed.translation: Tidak dapat menyimpan tugas: {error}. Video mungkin masih diproses

notice.job.alreadyRunning.original: This video is already being processed

modal.template.var.title.desc.original: - The title of the Youtube video

modal.template.var.videoUrl.desc.original: - The URL of the Youtube video

modal.template.var.summary.desc.original: - The LLM-generated summary of the video

modal.template.var.llmProvider.desc.original: - The LLM provider used (e.g., openai, anthropic)
modal.template.var.llmProvider.desc.translation: - Pembekal LLM yang digunakan (cth. openai, anthropic)

modal.template.var.llmModel.desc.original: - The specific model used (e.g., gpt-4, claude-3-opus)
modal.template.var.llmModel.desc.translation: - Model khusus yang digunakan (cth. gpt-4, claude-3-opus)

modal.template.var.llmTags.desc.original: - Tags generated from the LLM provider and model
modal.template.var.llmTags.desc.translation: - Teg yang dijana daripada pembekal dan model LLM

notice.models.providerSet.original: Provider set to {provider}. Output budget: {tokens} tokens (max output minus reserve).
notice.models.providerSet.translation: Pembekal ditetapkan kepada {provider}. Bajet output: {tokens} token (output maksimum tolak simpanan).

notice.models.modelChanged.original: Model changed to {model}. Output budget: {tokens} tokens (max output minus reserve).
notice.models.modelChanged.translation: Model ditukar kepada {model}. Bajet output: {tokens} token (output maksimum tolak simpanan).

notice.models.refreshFailed.original: Could not refresh {provider} models. Using existing list.
notice.models.refreshFailed.translation: Tidak dapat menyegar semula model {provider}. Senarai sedia ada akan digunakan.

notice.collection.noVideos.playlist.original: No videos found in this playlist
notice.collection.noVideos.playlist.translation: Tiada video ditemui dalam senarai main ini

notice.collection.noVideos.channel.original: No videos found in this channel
notice.collection.noVideos.channel.translation: Tiada video ditemui dalam saluran ini

notice.models.refreshedWithLimits.other.original: {provider} model list refreshed. Token limits auto-populated for {count} models.
notice.models.refreshedWithLimits.other.translation: Senarai model {provider} telah disegar semula. Had token diisi automatik untuk {count} model.

notice.note.done.timestampsEdited.original: Note created, but timestamps were skipped because the note was edited
notice.note.done.timestampsEdited.translation: Nota dicipta, tetapi cap masa dilangkau kerana nota disunting

notice.note.done.translationEdited.original: Note created, but the translation was skipped because the note was edited
notice.note.done.translationEdited.translation: Nota dicipta, tetapi terjemahan dilangkau kerana nota disunting

notice.note.done.bothEdited.original: Note created, but timestamps and the translation were skipped because the note was edited
notice.note.done.bothEdited.translation: Nota dicipta, tetapi cap masa dan terjemahan dilangkau kerana nota disunting

notice.note.done.withoutBoth.original: Note created without timestamps or translation
notice.note.done.withoutBoth.translation: Nota dicipta tanpa cap masa dan tanpa terjemahan

common.transcript.unavailable.original: No transcript is available for this video
